rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Synthetic Identity Credit Utilization Spike")`
`comment("Detects 6+ months low utilization followed by rapid spike to >80%")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:credit_monitoring
  (account_type="consumer_credit" OR account_type="credit_card")
  trailing_6m_avg_utilization_pct<35
  current_utilization_pct>=80
  previous_month_utilization_pct<50
| eval utilization_jump = current_utilization_pct - previous_month_utilization_pct
| eval risk_score = case(
    utilization_jump > 70 AND trailing_6m_avg_utilization_pct < 20, "critical",
    utilization_jump > 50, "high",
    1=1, "medium")
| table account_id, account_type, credit_limit, current_balance,
        current_utilization_pct, trailing_6m_avg_utilization_pct,
        previous_month_utilization_pct, utilization_jump,
        account_open_date, risk_score
| sort - utilization_jump
rules.title: DL-0151: Synthetic Identity Credit Utilization Spike — Low-and-Slow Buildup Followed by Bust-Out (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for First-Party Credit Buildup and Sudden Spike")`
`comment("Detects 6+ months good payments followed by utilization spike and missed payment")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:credit_monitoring
  (account_type="consumer_credit" OR account_type="credit_card")
  on_time_payment_months>=6
  previous_avg_utilization_pct<40
  current_utilization_pct>=85
  days_since_first_missed_payment<=60
  days_since_utilization_spike<=60
| eval utilization_jump = current_utilization_pct - previous_avg_utilization_pct
| eval risk_score = case(
    utilization_jump > 60 AND on_time_payment_months >= 12, "critical",
    utilization_jump > 45, "high",
    1=1, "medium")
| table account_id, account_type, credit_limit, current_balance,
        current_utilization_pct, previous_avg_utilization_pct,
        utilization_jump, on_time_payment_months,
        days_since_first_missed_payment, account_open_date, risk_score
| sort - utilization_jump
rules.title: DL-0155: First-Party Credit Buildup and Sudden Spike (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Never-Pay Pattern")`
`comment("Detects new accounts with immediate high utilization and zero payments")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:credit_monitoring
  (account_type="consumer_credit" OR account_type="credit_card")
  account_age_days<=90
  current_utilization_pct>=75
  total_payments_made=0
  billing_cycles_elapsed>=1
| eval spend_velocity = round(current_balance / account_age_days, 2)
| eval risk_score = case(
    current_utilization_pct >= 95 AND billing_cycles_elapsed >= 2, "critical",
    current_utilization_pct >= 85, "high",
    1=1, "medium")
| table account_id, account_type, credit_limit, current_balance,
        current_utilization_pct, account_age_days, billing_cycles_elapsed,
        spend_velocity, account_open_date, risk_score
| sort - current_utilization_pct
rules.title: DL-0156: Never-Pay Pattern — Immediate Max Utilization with Zero Payments (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Rapid Authorized User Addition")`
`comment("Detects same individual added as authorized user on 3+ accounts in 30 days")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:credit_monitoring
  event_type="authorized_user_added"
  earliest=-30d@d latest=now
| stats dc(account_id) as distinct_account_count,
        values(account_id) as accounts,
        values(primary_account_holder_id) as primary_holders,
        min(event_date) as first_addition,
        max(event_date) as last_addition
  by authorized_user_id, authorized_user_name
| where distinct_account_count >= 3
| eval addition_span_days = round((strptime(last_addition, "%Y-%m-%d") - strptime(first_addition, "%Y-%m-%d")) / 86400, 0)
| eval risk_score = case(
    distinct_account_count >= 5, "critical",
    distinct_account_count >= 4, "high",
    1=1, "medium")
| table authorized_user_id, authorized_user_name, distinct_account_count,
        accounts, primary_holders, first_addition, last_addition,
        addition_span_days, risk_score
| sort - distinct_account_count
rules.title: DL-0157: Rapid Authorized User Addition Across Multiple Accounts (SPLUNK)
